newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese escudo breaks below 101 per mark.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese escudo breaks below 101 per mark.

text.p: The Portuguese escudo continued to strengthen on Thursday, breaking below the psychological level of 101.00 to the mark, dealers said.
The currency touched 100.93 to the German currency before slipping back to 101.01/06 at 0846 GMT.
The escudo has benefitted from the general strength of other European currencies against the mark.
But it is being given an extra push by mounting confidence Portugal can qualify for the first wave of the European Union's planned single currency.
